_comment: Branch forensics for the oasis-tcs/ubl repository.
This file records information that CANNOT be derived from git alone:
branch renames, fast-forward merges, bookmarks, and deleted branches.
Sources: GitHub Activity API, GitHub Actions workflow runs, git reflog.

branch_renames.evidence: GitHub Activity API: ubl-2.5 branch_creation at 07:39:55Z, ubl-2.5-csd01 branch_deletion at 07:40:56Z — 61 seconds apart by same actor.
branch_renames.trunk_positions: Covers trunk positions ~107-127 (pushed as ubl-2.5-csd01), then 128+ (as ubl-2.5). Confirmed by workflow runs: sha=153236e at trunk[125] pushed to ubl-2.5-csd01, sha=0e6caf4 at trunk[128] pushed to ubl-2.5.
branch_renames.notes: ubl-2.5-csd01 was the active trunk branch for over a year (March 2024 — April 2025). Three contributors pushed to it: klakegg (creator), kduvekot, bdxhub, gkholman. The branch ref no longer exists — it is invisible in the git data.

bookmarks.evidence: GitHub Activity API: 0 pushes. Commit 4c0ffc3 was pushed to ubl-2.5 at 19:38:24Z (44 min after branch creation). Branch created 27 seconds after commit was authored (18:53:40Z).
bookmarks.notes: Retroactive bookmark marking the end of JIRA issue UBL-433 work. The 3 commits (d35a880, e41bda8, 4c0ffc3) were all pushed directly to ubl-2.5. No merge commit or PR exists.

bookmarks.evidence: GitHub Activity API: 0 pushes. Branch tip is at same commit as ubl-2.4-csd02-tsc.
bookmarks.notes: Bookmark marking the PRD01-13 milestone on the trunk. Same tip as ubl-2.4-csd02-tsc.

bookmarks.evidence: GitHub Activity API: 0 pushes. Same trunk position as ubl-2.4-csd02-prd01-13.
bookmarks.notes: Bookmark marking the TSC review point. Created 2 weeks after ubl-2.4-csd02-prd01-13 at the same commit.
Bookmark marking the CS01 working state. Created same day as several other branches (csd01-temp, revert-24, test-2.4cs01).

bookmarks.evidence: GitHub Activity API: 26 pushes (2025-05-08 to 2025-06-12). Workflow runs confirm: 2 commits (trunk[163-164]) were pushed to ubl-2.5-dev, but the rest went to ubl-2.5. All first-parent commits are on the trunk (0 unique).
bookmarks.notes: Not a pure bookmark — this was a real development branch that ran in parallel with ubl-2.5 from May-June 2025. However, all its commits also landed on ubl-2.5 (the trunk). Created one month AFTER ubl-2.5 already existed. Think of it as a parallel workspace that was kept in sync with the trunk.
Bookmark or test branch. Created at a point off the trunk first-parent chain.
Bookmark or retry branch. Created same day as server-test and kentest recreation.

pr_branches.notes: PR#27 source branch. Merged into ubl-2.4-cs01, which is on the trunk. Branch deleted after merge.
Source branch for PR#24 (merged into ubl-2.4-csd01) and PR#26 (merged into ubl-2.4-csd01). Deleted timestamp appears before creation — likely API clock skew or recreated.
PR#28 source branch. Short-lived feature branch (5 days). Merged into ubl-2.5 on the trunk.

ephemeral_branches.notes: Extremely short-lived test branch. Created and deleted within 3 minutes.
Debug branch used for 3 hours with 5 pushes. Same day as kendebug2 and kentest.
Second debug branch, parallel to kendebug.
Test branch. Note: this is different from 'kentest' (no hyphen).
Stale temporary branch. Created same day as test-2.4cs01 and revert-24. Never pushed to, deleted 6 months later during cleanup.
Unused revert branch for PR#24. Never pushed to, deleted same day as csd01-temp.

recreated_branches.notes: Test branch that was deleted and recreated 3 times on 2026-01-21 (same day). Originally created 2024-05-30. The recreations suggest the developer was resetting the branch to different starting points.

pre_api_branches.notes: Original default branch. Predates Activity API retention. 1 recorded push (2025-10-08 by kduvekot: 'sync main repo build.yml'). Creation date unknown.
Predates Activity API. 0 recorded pushes. Tip at trunk[36]. Cannot determine if this was a working branch or bookmark.
Predates Activity API. 0 recorded pushes. Has 1 unique non-trunk commit (PR#20 merge). PR-merged branch that continued to receive merges after trunk diverged.
Predates Activity API. 0 recorded pushes, 1 pr_merge recorded. Has 1 unique non-trunk commit (PR#24 merge). Similar to ubl-2.4-csd01wd02.

trunk_active_branch_timeline._comment: The actual branch name that was used for trunk work at each period. Combines git structure with GitHub API evidence.

segments.source: Activity API: 18 pushes + workflow runs. RENAMED to ubl-2.5 on 2025-04-09.
Activity API: 168 pushes + workflow runs. Some commits at trunk[163-164] were also pushed to ubl-2.5-dev.

methodology.github_activity_api: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#list-repository-activities — provides branch creation, deletion, push, and PR merge events. Retention appears to go back to ~2023 for this repo.
methodology.github_actions_workflow_runs: Workflow runs record headBranch and headSha, providing evidence of which branch was pushed. Only available since workflows were configured (~April 2025).
methodology.git_first_parent_chain: git rev-list --first-parent origin/ubl-2.5 gives the 328-commit trunk. Branch tips on this chain were classified as FF-MERGE or BOOKMARK.
limitations: Activity API has finite retention — events for branches created before ~2023 may be missing.
Branches created before the Activity API existed (main, ubl-2.4-csd01wd01, ubl-2.4-csd01wd02, ubl-2.4-csd01) have no creation events.
Workflow runs only exist since ~April 2025 when build.yml was configured.
Fast-forward merges leave no trace in git — only the stale branch ref reveals them.
If a bookmark branch ref is ever deleted, the knowledge is lost permanently.
